posts.title: clarity for builders
posts.description: clarity is the hidden unfair advantage. when you know exactly what you want to build, you move faster, you avoid the fake work, and you say no to every shiny distraction. most people drift; the ones who get somewhere decide where they’re going and keep checking the compass. clarity is the compass.
